column1: ## Establishes cognitive architecture: learnability, suggestion, science-as-reach, headroom, math-as-precognition, God-as-Science.

column4: The classifier must learn from every classification outcome — true positives refine patterns, false positives prune rules. No classification is wasted data.
Threat scores are cognitive suggestions to the administrator — weighted evidence, not verdicts. The human decides action; the classifier informs.
Security science is a reach class — each new attack vector extends the frontier of what must be understood. The classifier reaches toward unknown threats, not just known signatures.
The heuristic model is headroom above signature-based detection. It represents the capacity to identify what has never been seen before — treatment of potential, not catalog.
Rate calculations, geo-concentration statistics, and port-scan correlations are precognitive — they detect intent before damage occurs. Math models the cause of attack before the effect lands.
The fundamental distinction between legitimate and malicious intent is unmovable. The classifier discovers this boundary through evidence; it does not define morality — it serves it.
